title: "ajusted means screening a fabae"
format: pdf
editor: visual
---

instalation of all the required package

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("lme4"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("Hmisc"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("corrplot"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("emmeans"))

```

preparation of the data based on the result from the filtering script :

```{r}
data250fabae <- read.csv("../../01_phenotipic_analysis/aphis_fabae_data_filtered.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = ",") %>%  mutate(genotype = as.factor(genotype)) %>% mutate(session = as.factor(session)) 
```

```{r}
data250fabae %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = larvae_total_number)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "white", color = "black") 
```

```{r}
model0 <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ 1, data = data250fabae)
model1 <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ ivip, data = data250fabae)
model2 <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + (1 | session), data = data250fabae)
model3 <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + (1 | session/block), data = data250fabae)
model4 <- glm.nb(formula = larvae_total_number ~ ivip +session/block, data = data250fabae)
model5 <- glm.nb(formula = larvae_total_number ~ ivip +session, data = data250fabae)
```

```{r}
compare_performance(model0, model1, model2,model3,model4,model5, rank = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
```

```{r}
test_lrt(model0, model1)
```

```{r}
test_lrt(model1, model2)
```

```{r}
test_lrt(model2, model3)
```

```{r}

anova(model3)

#variance stability





# Extract fitted values and residuals
fitted_values <- fitted(model3)
residuals_values <- residuals(model3)

#homosedasticity
# Plot residuals vs fitted values
plot(fitted_values, residuals_values, 
     main="Residuals vs Fitted", 
     xlab="Fitted values", 
     ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0, col="red")

#residual normality
hist(residuals_values, main="Histogram of Residuals", xlab="Residuals", breaks=20)
# 2. Q-Q Plot for Residuals
qqnorm(residuals_values)
qqline(residuals_values, col = "red")

#residual independance
# Plot residuals over time (for time-series data)
plot(residuals(model3), type="o", col="blue", main="Residuals over Time", xlab="Index", ylab="Residuals")


# Extract EMMeans for genotype
emm_genotype <- emmeans(model3, ~ ivip)
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_genotype)
hist(emm_df$emmean)

emm_df <- emm_df[,c(1,2)]

# Define the file path
file_path <- "~/Documents/gitrepo/faba_specifics/02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/emmeans_fabae.csv"

# Save the data frame to the specified location
  write.csv(emm_df, file = file_path, row.names = FALSE)


```
